description: Implementation of the CalendarRepository interface, providing methods to retrieve and add calendar events, leaves, and astrology details using DAOs and Kotlin coroutines Flow.

classes.name: CalendarRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of CalendarRepository providing calendar, leave, and astrology data management.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a flow of calendar events for the specified month and year.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Adds a new calendar event to the data source.

methods.name: getAstrologyDetails
methods.description: Fetches astrology details for a specific date.
